mentions.name: PromptSlice
mentions.description: A web tool for creating, testing, and optimizing prompts, tools, and context for AI agents. It provides a first-class prompt editor with Cursor-style chat where users can ask it to make tweaks, overhaul sections, and optimize ambiguity, distinguishing it from other prompt editors like Langsmith.
mentions.problem: The author needed a way to create, test, and optimize prompts while building agents for other use cases, and existing prompt editors lacked a first-class prompt editor with chat-based editing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building promptslice.com as a way to create, test, and optimize prompts + tools + context. I needed it when building agents for other use cases so I built it. Unlike Langsmith and some of the other prompt editors, this has a first class editor for your prompt with "Cursor style" chat where you can ask it to make tweaks, overhaul sections, optimize ambiguity, etc.
